01All year round

What is always included

CHF 0

Travel included in Geneva

Free across the whole canton of Geneva. In Vaud, a flat CHF 39.90 or 59.90 incl. VAT depending on the district — see the zones. Conventional agencies charge up to CHF 100 everywhere.

CHF 0

Large vehicle surcharge

SUV, people carrier or saloon, the price is the same. Elsewhere, expect up to CHF 50 more.

VAT

8.1% VAT included, no hidden fees. A 30% deposit confirms the appointment, the balance is settled on site.
